title: Report - Communist Meeting In Western Chapei, Chinese Controlled Territory, On May 10, 1933

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No.
No. D 3374/21
S.B. Sp./Pr. 723
Date May 11, 1933

Subject (in full) Communist Meeting in Western Chapel, Chinese controlled
territory, on May 10, 1933.

Made by D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

Between 6 and 7 p.m. May 10, 1933, seven communist
adherents held a meeting in a hut, situate at the east of the
Dah Foong (大豐) Cotton Mill, Tan Ts Wan (潭子湾), Western
Chapei, O.O.L. The gathering which was presided over by
Li Siao Oo Ts (李幼士), member of the Shanghai Western
Special District Committee of the local Chinese Communist
Party, passed the following resolutions :-
1) That new methods be introduced into the economic struggles
of workers (i.e. to oppose the 5-day shift, etc.) and that
regulations governing such struggles be given publicity.
2) That members of the executive staff be exempted from
factory work.
3) That "Sisters' Groups" be organized.
4) That the cells of certain factories which have hitherto
enjoyed a good record in Party activities make preparations
for the observance of the "May 30 Anniversary" and that
efforts be made to convert 100 male and 300 female workers.

The description of Li Siao Oo Ts is as follows :-
Age about 25, height 5'3", long face, dark complexion,
native of Kompo, last seen wearing a blue cotton jacket and pants,
and black cotton shoes.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
[Signature]
C. I/c Sp. Br.
MAY 12 1933
